opportunities.name: Storm shred corridor
opportunities.objective: Use terrain to hold targets through stacking magic effects.
opportunities.mechanic: Glacial Storm triples its damage after 1.5 seconds and then chills for doubled Frostbite, whose base 0.55 AP becomes 1.1 AP on chilled targets. Bloodletter's Curse rewards repeated ability magic hits; Blackfire Torch and Malignance add area pressure. Crystallize makes remaining in that fully formed storm more realistic.
opportunities.requiredState: Need mana, a held corridor and R uninterrupted long enough to form.
opportunities.failure: Leaving the storm, interrupting the toggle or mana exhaustion leaves an expensive low-mobility build exposed.
opportunities.test: Track shred stacks, time inside R and doubled E damage over four seconds.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R damage is not immediately tripled at the first tick.

opportunities.name: Egg siege survivor
opportunities.objective: Buy time for the six-second Rebirth transformation.
opportunities.mechanic: Rebirth returns Anivia to a full-health egg with level-dependent defenses and requires six seconds of survival. Rod of Ages health and Seraph's shield support the initial life; Zhonya's can delay burst before lethal damage, while Q stun and W terrain limit access. AP retains the doubled E threat that discourages enemy commitment.
opportunities.requiredState: Need charged Tear, aged Rod, Rebirth ready and teammates able to defend the egg.
opportunities.failure: A stationary egg remains easy to focus; delaying death may allow opponents to surround it.
opportunities.test: Compare time survived before egg and egg survival against one versus three attackers.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Do not assume active items can be cast while egg-bound or the Seraph shield resets on Rebirth.

ruledOut.reason: Rebirth is a survival state, not a turret or independently attacking pet.

unknowns: Egg item-state inheritance and automatic shield timing require live checks; raw armor interpolation flags remain ambiguous.

testPlan: Required state: Need mana, a held corridor and R uninterrupted long enough to form.
Track shred stacks, time inside R and doubled E damage over four seconds.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Leaving the storm, interrupting the toggle or mana exhaustion leaves an expensive low-mobility build exposed.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: R damage is not immediately tripled at the first tick.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blackfire Torch, Bloodletter's Curse, Malignance, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Toggle: Anivia calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail that Slows enemies by [20 / 30 / 40]% and deals [30 / 45 / 60 + (0.125) × AP] magic damage per second. The storm increases in size over [1.5] seconds.

When the storm is fully formed, it Chills, Slows by [30 / 45 / 60]%, and does [(30 / 45 / 60 + (0.125) × AP) × (3)] magic damage per second instead.

Anivia fires a massive chunk of ice, dealing [50 / 70 / 90 / 110 / 130 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage and Chilling enemies for [3] seconds, Slowing them by @Spell.GlacialStorm:SlowAmount@%. At the end of its range, the ice detonates, Stunning enemies for [1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 / 1.4 / 1.5] seconds and dealing [60 / 95 / 130 / 165 / 200 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage.

Anivia can Recast this ability while the ice flies to detonate it early.

Anivia blasts an enemy with a freezing wind, dealing [55 / 80 / 105 / 130 / 155 + (0.55) × AP] magic damage. Against Chilled enemies, Anivia deals [(55 / 80 / 105 / 130 / 155 + (0.55) × AP) × (2)] magic damage instead.
Anivia summons a wall of ice [400 / 500 / 600 / 700 / 800] units wide. The wall lasts for [5] seconds before it melts.
